translation.sourceText: Hebrew Masoretic text (Westminster Leningrad Codex base, Public Domain) — Tanach with Ta'amei Hamikra

verdicts.reasoning: Re-parsed: ûḏəḇar-YHWH hāyâ yāqār bayyāmîm hāhēm ʾên ḥāzôn nip̄rāṣ. 'rare ... no widespread vision' (changed from ASV 'precious ... no frequent vision') is the lexical sense HALOT gives for this verse and the modern consensus (McCarter; NRSV, NJPS). Not lens-motivated.

citations: Tov, Textual Criticism of the Hebrew Bible (3rd ed., 2012), on Ketiv/Qere
verdicts.reasoning: Ketiv wʿynw 'his eye' / Qere wəʿênāyw 'his eyes', Qere translated. bayyôm hahûʾ 'at that time' (ASV) is idiomatic. Exact.
wənēr ʾĕlōhîm ṭerem yiḵbeh ... bəhêḵal YHWH ʾăšer-šām ʾărôn ʾĕlōhîm: two anarthrous genitives rendered without article (clause 2); hêḵāl 'temple'. Exact.
wayyiqrāʾ YHWH ʾel-šəmûʾēl: single call in the MT (LXX doubled, McCarter adopts it), MT kept. hinnēnî 'Here am I'. Correct.
hinnənî kî-qārāʾṯā llî ... lōʾ-qārāʾṯî šûḇ šəḵāḇ: exact. Non-blocking: the note transliterates the form as *hinnəḵî*; the source has הִנְנִי, read *hinnənî*.
wayyōsep̄ YHWH qərōʾ ʿôḏ šəmûʾēl ... bənî: exact.
ṭerem yāḏaʿ ʾeṯ-YHWH wəṭerem yiggāleh ʾēlāyw dəḇar-YHWH: exact.
bašəlîšîṯ ... wayyāḇen ʿēlî kî YHWH qōrēʾ lannāʿar: exact.
lēḵ šəḵāḇ wəhāyâ ʾim-yiqrāʾ ʾēleyḵā wəʾāmartā dabbēr YHWH kî šōmēaʿ ʿaḇdeḵā: literal; participle 'is listening'. Reception note accurately reports TBWTT ch. 3.

Re-parsed: wayyāḇōʾ YHWH wayyiṯyaṣṣaḇ wayyiqrāʾ kəp̄aʿam-bəp̄aʿam šəmûʾēl šəmûʾēl. 'came and stood' is the ASV-literal rendering of a bold Hebrew anthropomorphism; neither softened nor heightened. The note points to hammarʾâ (v 15). Reception note (telepathy, radio-amateur analogy) accurately reports TBWTT ch. 3 and is confined to apparatus.
hinnê ʾānōḵî ʿōśeh ḏāḇār ... tiṣṣillênâ šəttê ʾozənāyw: participle of imminent future 'I am about to do'. Exact.
ʾāqîm ʾel-ʿēlî ... hāḥēl wəḵallēh 'from beginning to end'. Exact.

kî-məqalləlîm lāhem bānāyw: MT translated ('bringing a curse on themselves'); the tiqqun soferim and LXX 'speaking evil of God' are accurately reported. wəlōʾ kihâ bām 'did not restrain them'. Correct under the MT-baseline rule.
ʾim-yiṯkappēr ... ʿaḏ-ʿôlām: oath ʾim = negative, 'shall not be atoned for'. Exact.
wayyiškaḇ šəmûʾēl ʿaḏ-habbōqer wayyip̄taḥ ʾeṯ-daltôṯ bêṯ-YHWH ... mēhaggîḏ ʾeṯ-hammarʾâ: exact.
šəmûʾēl bənî ... hinnēnî: exact.

citations: 1 Sam 14:44; 2 Sam 3:9 (MT; same oath with singular verb)
verdicts.reasoning: kōh yaʿăśeh-lləḵā ʾĕlōhîm wəḵōh yôsîp̄: singular verbs, anarthrous; 'So may Elohim do to you, and more also' matches the ratified 1 Kgs 2:23 rendering. Exact.
YHWH hûʾ haṭṭôḇ bəʿênāw yaʿăśeh: exact.
wəlōʾ-hippîl mikkol-dəḇārāyw ʾārṣâ 'let none of his words fall to the ground'. Exact; the `eretz` citation was rightly removed ('ground').
middān wəʿaḏ-bəʾēr šāḇaʿ ... neʾĕmān ... lənāḇîʾ laYHWH 'established as a prophet'. Exact.
wayyōsep̄ YHWH ləhērāʾōh bəšilōh kî-niḡlâ YHWH ... bidḇar YHWH: exact; the LXX plus at 3:21-4:1 is reported and not translated.

After reading it, no verdict changed. The report confirms it did not check the shofar Exodus refIds (the reviewer did: EXO-WOH-20:15, not 20:18) and names the ark collision risk (the reviewer checked exodus-woh chapter-25 and the Torah diff: no ʾărôn entry exists there; six Ex 25 refIds should join the central entry). The report's statement that NJPS follows 'stone' at 1 Sam 6:18 was not verifiable from the shelf and is not relied on.

founderDecisionRecommendations.1-1Sam-6:18-great-stone: Ship. ʾāḇēl cannot be construed (two failed agreements, contradiction with vv 14-15); ʾeḇen with LXX, Targum and some Hebrew MSS is the standard correction (Driver 1913; McCarter 1980). Ratify the exception exactly as narrowly worded (MT grammatically impossible + Hebrew-manuscript reading supported by the versions).
founderDecisionRecommendations.2-gentilics: Keep the Kings '-ite' rule in the Former Prophets now (option c); it maps one-to-one to the ASV and is already ratified for Kings. For the later corpus pass, the reviewer prefers (a) '-ite' throughout, with the central pelishtim-caphtor plural becoming 'the Pelishtites', because 'the Pelishtite' beside 'the Pelishtim' is the one jarring pair. No philological issue either way; it is a presentation choice.
founderDecisionRecommendations.3-Judg-6:40-the-Elohim: Confirm. The ratified Kings text explicitly leaves the central narrative-subject rule ('the Elohim') in force and limits the article-less form to predicates, genitives and direct-speech subjects; the brief's paraphrase was inaccurate. Clause 6 applies the ratified text exactly.
founderDecisionRecommendations.4-Judg-6:34-clothed: Ship. lāḇəšâ is literally 'clothed' (BDB; same idiom 1 Chr 12:19; 2 Chr 24:20; Block), and keeping Judges' four verbs distinct is a gain in accuracy.
founderDecisionRecommendations.5-herem: Ship. 'devote(d) to destruction' is the standard modern rendering (NRSV; HALOT) and the only consistent one; it makes the Josh 6 / Josh 10 connection visible without moral editorializing.
founderDecisionRecommendations.6-shofar-promotion: Approve the promotion after the refId fix (EXO-WOH-20:15 for 20:18; optionally add EXO-WOH-19:13). Retire the 1-kings-woh shofar entry to a pointer and let the exodus-woh overlays cite the central id.

paragraphs.text: וְהַנַּ֧עַר שְׁמוּאֵ֛ל מְשָׁרֵ֥ת אֶת־יְהוָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י עֵלִ֑י וּדְבַר־יְהוָ֗ה הָיָ֤ה יָקָר֙ בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם אֵ֥ין חָז֖וֹן נִפְרָֽץ׃ (ס)

i18n.en: And the boy Shemu'el was ministering to YHWH before Eli. And the word of YHWH was rare in those days; there was no widespread vision.

notes.official: *wəhannaʿar šəmûʾēl məšārēṯ ʾeṯ-YHWH lip̄nê ʿēlî* 'And the boy Shemu'el was ministering to YHWH before Eli' (Shemu'el = Samuel). *ûḏəḇar-YHWH hāyâ yāqār bayyāmîm hāhēm ʾên ḥāzôn nip̄rāṣ* 'And the word of YHWH was rare in those days; there was no widespread vision' (ASV 'precious ... no frequent vision'): *yāqār* is 'precious' and, of what is valued because scarce, 'rare' (HALOT), and the parallel clause shows that scarcity is the point; *nip̄rāṣ* (Niphal of *prṣ* 'break out, spread') is vision that 'spreads abroad' (McCarter, *I Samuel*, AB 8, 1980; NRSV, NJPS) (`yaqar-chazon-nifratz-word-rare-vision-1-samuel-3-1`). The verse frames the chapter, which ends with YHWH revealing himself again at Shiloh (v 21).

paragraphs.text: וַֽיְהִי֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא וְעֵלִ֖י שֹׁכֵ֣ב בִּמְקֹמ֑וֹ ועינו [וְעֵינָיו֙] הֵחֵ֣לּוּ כֵה֔וֹת לֹ֥א יוּכַ֖ל לִרְאֽוֹת׃

i18n.en: And it came to pass at that time, when Eli was lying down in his place — now his eyes had begun to grow dim, so that he could not see —

notes.official: *wəʿênāyw* 'his eyes' translates the Qere; the Ketiv *wʿynw* is the singular 'his eye' (`ketiv-qere-qere-translated-former-prophets`). *hēḥēllû ḵēhôṯ lōʾ yûḵal lirʾôṯ* 'had begun to grow dim, so that he could not see' (`kahah-eynayim-patriarchal-blindness-narrative-trigger`): Eli's failing sight matches the lack of vision in v 1.

paragraphs.text: וְנֵ֤ר אֱלֹהִים֙ טֶ֣רֶם יִכְבֶּ֔ה וּשְׁמוּאֵ֖ל שֹׁכֵ֑ב בְּהֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־שָׁ֖ם אֲר֥וֹן אֱלֹהִֽים׃ (פ)

i18n.en: and the lamp of Elohim had not yet gone out, and Shemu'el was lying down in the temple of YHWH, where the ark of Elohim was,

notes.official: *wənēr ʾĕlōhîm ṭerem yiḵbeh* 'and the lamp of Elohim had not yet gone out': the sanctuary lamp burned from evening to morning (Ex 27:20-21; Lev 24:2-3), so the call comes before dawn. *nēr ʾĕlōhîm* and *ʾărôn ʾĕlōhîm* are anarthrous genitives, without article (clause 2 of `elohim-referent-and-article-conventions-former-prophets`). *bəhêḵal YHWH* 'in the temple of YHWH': *hêḵāl* of the whole sanctuary at Shiloh, rendered 'temple' as at 1 Sam 1:9 (central `ulam-hekhal-devir-temple-three-room-plan-cross-corpus`). *ʾăšer-šām ʾărôn ʾĕlōhîm* 'where the ark of Elohim was' (proposed central `aron-ark-of-the-covenant-ark-of-the-elohim-cross-corpus`).

paragraphs.text: וַיִּקְרָ֧א יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הִנֵּֽנִי׃

i18n.en: that YHWH called Shemu'el; and he said, "Here am I."

notes.official: *wayyiqrāʾ YHWH ʾel-šəmûʾēl* 'that YHWH called Shemu'el': a single call in the MT, doubled in the LXX ('Samuel, Samuel'). *hinnēnî* 'Here am I' (`hineni-prophetic-response-formula`).

paragraphs.text: וַיָּ֣רָץ אֶל־עֵלִ֗י וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הִנְנִי֙ כִּֽי־קָרָ֣אתָ לִּ֔י וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לֹֽא־קָרָ֖אתִי שׁ֣וּב שְׁכָ֑ב וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ וַיִּשְׁכָּֽב׃ (ס)

i18n.en: And he ran to Eli and said, "Here am I, for you called me." And he said, "I did not call; lie down again." And he went and lay down.

notes.official: *hinnənî kî-qārāʾṯā llî* 'Here am I, for you called me' (`hineni-prophetic-response-formula`). *šûḇ šəḵāḇ* 'lie down again'.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֣סֶף יְהוָ֗ה קְרֹ֣א עוֹד֮ שְׁמוּאֵל֒ וַיָּ֤קָם שְׁמוּאֵל֙ וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ אֶל־עֵלִ֔י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הִנְנִ֔י כִּ֥י קָרָ֖אתָ לִ֑י וַיֹּ֛אמֶר לֹֽא־קָרָ֥אתִי בְנִ֖י שׁ֥וּב שְׁכָֽב׃

i18n.en: And YHWH called yet again, "Shemu'el!" And Shemu'el arose and went to Eli and said, "Here am I, for you called me." And he said, "I did not call, my son; lie down again."

notes.official: *wayyōsep̄ YHWH qərōʾ ʿôḏ šəmûʾēl* 'And YHWH called yet again, Shemu'el!'; *bənî* 'my son'.

paragraphs.text: וּשְׁמוּאֵ֕ל טֶ֖רֶם יָדַ֣ע אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה וְטֶ֛רֶם יִגָּלֶ֥ה אֵלָ֖יו דְּבַר־יְהוָֽה׃

i18n.en: Now Shemu'el did not yet know YHWH, and the word of YHWH had not yet been revealed to him.

notes.official: *ṭerem yāḏaʿ ʾeṯ-YHWH* 'did not yet know YHWH' is explained by the parallel clause: the word of YHWH had not yet been revealed to him. The narrator explains why he mistook the voice.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֨סֶף יְהוָ֥ה קְרֹא־שְׁמוּאֵל֮ בַּשְּׁלִשִׁית֒ וַיָּ֙קָם֙ וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ אֶל־עֵלִ֔י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הִנְנִ֔י כִּ֥י קָרָ֖אתָ לִ֑י וַיָּ֣בֶן עֵלִ֔י כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה קֹרֵ֥א לַנָּֽעַר׃

i18n.en: And YHWH called Shemu'el again the third time. And he arose and went to Eli and said, "Here am I, for you called me." And Eli perceived that YHWH was calling the boy.

notes.official: *wayyāḇen ʿēlî kî YHWH qōrēʾ lannāʿar* 'And Eli perceived that YHWH was calling the boy'.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר עֵלִ֣י לִשְׁמוּאֵל֮ לֵ֣ךְ שְׁכָב֒ וְהָיָה֙ אִם־יִקְרָ֣א אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ דַּבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י שֹׁמֵ֖עַ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וַיִּשְׁכַּ֖ב בִּמְקוֹמֽוֹ׃

i18n.en: Therefore Eli said to Shemu'el, "Go, lie down; and it shall be, if he calls you, that you shall say, 'Speak, YHWH, for your servant is listening.'" So Shemu'el went and lay down in his place.

notes.official:
*dabbēr YHWH kî šōmēaʿ ʿaḇdeḵā* 'Speak, YHWH, for your servant is listening' (ASV 'heareth'): the participle *šōmēaʿ* 'is listening'.

**Wheel of Heaven reading (reception note, not a translation claim).** The Book Which Tells the Truth (ch. 3) quotes this verse as Eli's instruction in an initiation into telepathy; see the note at v 10. The line renders the instruction literally.

paragraphs.text: וַיָּבֹ֤א יְהוָה֙ וַיִּתְיַצַּ֔ב וַיִּקְרָ֥א כְפַֽעַם־בְּפַ֖עַם שְׁמוּאֵ֣ל ׀ שְׁמוּאֵ֑ל וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ דַּבֵּ֔ר כִּ֥י שֹׁמֵ֖עַ עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃ (פ)

i18n.en: And YHWH came and stood, and called as at the other times, "Shemu'el, Shemu'el!" Then Shemu'el said, "Speak, for your servant is listening."

notes.official:
*wayyāḇōʾ YHWH wayyiṯyaṣṣaḇ* 'And YHWH came and stood' (ASV): the Hithpael of *yṣb* 'take one's stand, present oneself', used of YHWH standing with Moshe at Ex 34:5 and of the messenger blocking Bil'am's way at Num 22:22. The narrator later calls the experience a vision (*hammarʾâ*, v 15), and the line renders the verbs literally. *kəp̄aʿam-bəp̄aʿam* 'as at the other times'. *šəmûʾēl šəmûʾēl* 'Shemu'el, Shemu'el!' is the doubled call (`doubled-name-call-theophanic-formula`; Gen 22:11; 46:2; Ex 3:4). Shemu'el's reply leaves out the divine name that Eli told him to say (v 9).

**Wheel of Heaven reading (reception note, not a translation claim).** The Book Which Tells the Truth (ch. 3) quotes vv 9-10 and reads the chapter as an initiation into telepathy: the creators seek contact with Shemu'el, who takes the voice for Eli's, and Eli teaches him how to answer, which the canon compares to radio amateurs opening a conversation. The line renders *qrʾ*, *bwʾ* and *yṣb* literally and does not encode that reading.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל הִנֵּ֧ה אָנֹכִ֛י עֹשֶׂ֥ה דָבָ֖ר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁר֙ כָּל־שֹׁ֣מְע֔וֹ תְּצִלֶּ֖ינָה שְׁתֵּ֥י אָזְנָֽיו׃

i18n.en: And YHWH said to Shemu'el, "Behold, I am about to do a thing in Yisra'el at which both ears of everyone who hears it shall tingle.

notes.official: *tiṣṣillênâ šəttê ʾozənāyw* 'both ears ... shall tingle' (2 Kgs 21:12; Jer 19:3).

paragraphs.text: בַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ אָקִ֣ים אֶל־עֵלִ֔י אֵ֛ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי אֶל־בֵּית֑וֹ הָחֵ֖ל וְכַלֵּֽה׃

i18n.en: On that day I will carry out against Eli all that I have spoken concerning his house, from beginning to end.

notes.official: *hāḥēl wəḵallēh* 'from beginning to end', literally 'beginning and finishing' (infinitives absolute). The word against Eli's house was given at 2:27-36.

paragraphs.text: וְהִגַּ֣דְתִּי ל֔וֹ כִּֽי־שֹׁפֵ֥ט אֲנִ֛י אֶת־בֵּית֖וֹ עַד־עוֹלָ֑ם בַּעֲוֺ֣ן אֲשֶׁר־יָדַ֗ע כִּֽי־מְקַֽלְלִ֤ים לָהֶם֙ בָּנָ֔יו וְלֹ֥א כִהָ֖ה בָּֽם׃

i18n.en: For I have told him that I am judging his house forever for the iniquity which he knew, because his sons were bringing a curse on themselves, and he did not restrain them.

notes.official: *kî-məqalləlîm lāhem bānāyw* 'because his sons were bringing a curse on themselves' (MT; ASV 'did bring a curse upon themselves'). Rabbinic tradition counts this verse among the *tiqqûnê sôp̄ərîm*, alterations made by the scribes out of reverence, and reconstructs the original as *məqalləlîm ʾĕlōhîm* 'were cursing Elohim', which the LXX reflects ('were speaking evil of God') (McCarthy, *The Tiqqune Sopherim*, OBO 36, 1981; McCarter, *I Samuel*). The MT is translated (`mt-baseline-at-versional-cruxes-former-prophets`; cf. central `tiqun-soferim-yhwh-stood-before-abraham` at Gen 18:22). *wəlōʾ kihâ bām* 'and he did not restrain them'. *bəʿăwōn* 'for the iniquity' (`avon-iniquity-cross-corpus-keyword`).

paragraphs.text: וְלָכֵ֥ן נִשְׁבַּ֖עְתִּי לְבֵ֣ית עֵלִ֑י אִֽם־יִתְכַּפֵּ֞ר עֲוֺ֧ן בֵּית־עֵלִ֛י בְּזֶ֥בַח וּבְמִנְחָ֖ה עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

i18n.en: And therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli that the iniquity of the house of Eli shall not be atoned for by sacrifice or meal-offering forever."

notes.official: *ʾim-yiṯkappēr* 'shall not be atoned for': *ʾim* in an oath is a negative. *bəzeḇaḥ ûḇəminḥâ* 'by sacrifice or meal-offering' (`qorbanot-sacrificial-offering-vocabulary-cluster-cross-corpus`).

paragraphs.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב שְׁמוּאֵל֙ עַד־הַבֹּ֔קֶר וַיִּפְתַּ֖ח אֶת־דַּלְת֣וֹת בֵּית־יְהוָ֑ה וּשְׁמוּאֵ֣ל יָרֵ֔א מֵהַגִּ֥יד אֶת־הַמַּרְאָ֖ה אֶל־עֵלִֽי׃

i18n.en: And Shemu'el lay until the morning; and he opened the doors of the house of YHWH. And Shemu'el was afraid to tell Eli the vision.

notes.official: *ʾeṯ-hammarʾâ* 'the vision': the narrator calls the night's call a vision (cf. v 1). *daltôṯ bêṯ-YHWH* 'the doors of the house of YHWH'.

paragraphs.text: וַיִּקְרָ֤א עֵלִי֙ אֶת־שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֖אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֣ל בְּנִ֑י וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הִנֵּֽנִי׃

i18n.en: Then Eli called Shemu'el and said, "Shemu'el, my son." And he said, "Here am I."

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מָ֤ה הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֣ר אֵלֶ֔יךָ אַל־נָ֥א תְכַחֵ֖ד מִמֶּ֑נִּי כֹּ֣ה יַעֲשֶׂה־לְּךָ֤ אֱלֹהִים֙ וְכֹ֣ה יוֹסִ֔יף אִם־תְּכַחֵ֤ד מִמֶּ֙נִּי֙ דָּבָ֔ר מִכָּל־הַדָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֶֽיךָ׃

i18n.en: And he said, "What is the word that he spoke to you? Please do not hide it from me. So may Elohim do to you, and more also, if you hide from me a word of all the word that he spoke to you."

notes.official: *kōh yaʿăśeh-lləḵā ʾĕlōhîm wəḵōh yôsîp̄* 'So may Elohim do to you, and more also': the Israelite oath with singular verbs, anarthrous 'Elohim' (clause 2 of `elohim-referent-and-article-conventions-former-prophets`), as 1 Kgs 2:23.

paragraphs.text: וַיַּגֶּד־ל֤וֹ שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶת־כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א כִחֵ֖ד מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וַיֹּאמַ֕ר יְהוָ֣ה ה֔וּא הַטּ֥וֹב בְּעֵינָ֖ו יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃ (פ)

i18n.en: So Shemu'el told him all the words and hid nothing from him. And he said, "It is YHWH; let him do what is good in his eyes."

notes.official: *YHWH hûʾ* 'It is YHWH'; *haṭṭôḇ bəʿênāyw yaʿăśeh* 'let him do what is good in his eyes'.

paragraphs.text: וַיִּגְדַּ֖ל שְׁמוּאֵ֑ל וַֽיהוָה֙ הָיָ֣ה עִמּ֔וֹ וְלֹֽא־הִפִּ֥יל מִכָּל־דְּבָרָ֖יו אָֽרְצָה׃

i18n.en: And Shemu'el grew, and YHWH was with him, and let none of his words fall to the ground.

notes.official: *waYHWH hāyâ ʿimmô* 'and YHWH was with him' (`elohim-imkha-divine-presence-formula`). *wəlōʾ-hippîl mikkol-dəḇārāyw ʾārṣâ* 'and let none of his words fall to the ground', that is, none failed (cf. 1 Kgs 8:56).

paragraphs.text: וַיֵּ֙דַע֙ כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִדָּ֖ן וְעַד־בְּאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע כִּ֚י נֶאֱמָ֣ן שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל לְנָבִ֖יא לַיהוָֽה׃

i18n.en: And all Yisra'el from Dan to Be'er Sheva knew that Shemu'el was established as a prophet of YHWH.

notes.official: *middān wəʿaḏ-bəʾēr šāḇaʿ* 'from Dan to Be'er Sheva' (Beersheba; `be-er-sheva-folk-etymology`), the north-south extent of the land. *kî neʾĕmān šəmûʾēl lənāḇîʾ laYHWH* 'that Shemu'el was established as a prophet of YHWH' (`navi-first-occurrence-abraham`): *neʾĕmān* also means 'trustworthy' (cf. 2:35).

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֥סֶף יְהוָ֖ה לְהֵרָאֹ֣ה בְשִׁלֹ֑ה כִּֽי־נִגְלָ֨ה יְהוָ֧ה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵ֛ל בְּשִׁל֖וֹ בִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ (פ)

i18n.en: And YHWH appeared again in Shiloh, for YHWH revealed himself to Shemu'el in Shiloh by the word of YHWH.

notes.official: *wayyōsep̄ YHWH ləhērāʾōh bəšilōh* 'And YHWH appeared again in Shiloh'; *kî-niḡlâ YHWH ʾel-šəmûʾēl* 'for YHWH revealed himself to Shemu'el'. The LXX has a longer text at the end of the verse, which is not translated (`mt-baseline-at-versional-cruxes-former-prophets`).
